notes.title: HSVR - Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Hunting Simulator VR will be getting major update within next two weeks. Main game mechanics are already finished and the only thing that's left there is to improve artificial intelligence. 

That's being said, next update will include much smarter animal AI, complete gutting system and improved teleportation system.

Once HSVR reaches version 2.0, our price will be increased to $14.99. There's also going to be a 2 weeks sale with 25% off starting on May 30th.

Keep posted!

notes.title: HSVR - Update 1.30
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I am happy to announce that the Update 1.30 is now LIVE and ready for the download!

Update Notes:

Player's Health System
Player's Hunger System
Cooking System
Consumption System
World Improvements


Although this update might seem minor for some of you, trust me, it took quite some time and was well worth it. Now, you have your own health system (to be expanded), as well as a hunger system. As time goes by, your hunger will deplete. When hunger reaches zero, your health will start to deplete as well.

Hence where Cooking System comes handy. In the future (next update), you will be able to harvest meat from killed animals. When you have raw meat on hand, you will be able to cook and then consume it.

Cooking System and Consuming System's are now implemented. So, head to the kitchen, fry it up and eat it! You deserve it! Your hunger will increase, as well as your health!

In all honesty. I am very excited about HSVR. I have many ideas that I would love to implement & as time permits, I will.

Thanks and happy hunting!

notes.title: HSVR - Update 1.25
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Update 1.25  is now LIVE and ready for the download. 

Update Notes:


 Improved passive A.I.
 New Predator A.I. Logic
 New Realistic Weapon Sounds
 Damage Multiplier System
 Minor bug fixes
 Minor code optimization


We wanted to wish every single one of you a Happy New 2019! We have big plans for HSVR, and the game still needs some improvements. We will be releasing Patch Update 1.25 by 1/5/19. Thanks, everyone!

notes.title: Patch 1.20.1218
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Patch is now LIVE and ready for the download. 

Patch Notes:


 Fixed User Interface issues.
 Increased weapons and attachments interaction distance.
 Now, weapons stay on hand on pickup but attachments drop on release.
 Improved teleportation system.
 Fixed and improved Animal AI.


Note: 

If you are still having issues with picking up weapons from the group, please make sure to recalibrate your HTC Vive (Room Setup). Animals still need some work, but our next update will be specifically focused on improving animal behavior. Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Issue With Release [Fixed]
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

There has been an issue with our release game build. We completely forgot to make the latest game build "LIVE" when we released the game last night. 

We apologize for missing that and making you try our first build, which happened to be the earliest version of it. 

Our release build is now LIVE and should be available for download. If the download hasn't started yet, please restart your Steam client.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Hunting Simulator VR - Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce that Hunting Simulator VR is now released and available for purchase. 10% off is active for the first week of sales, so do not miss your chance to pick up your copy at a discounted price!

Things to consider: 

Our game is on its active course of development and frequent updates are expected. If you encounter a bug, please report them in our community discussions: 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/983840/discussions/

We would like to be as transparent as possible with our community and will do our best to communicate with each of you and resolve any issues/bugs with the game as soon as possible.

Thanks a lot, everyone and have a great weekend!

notes.title: Delayed Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Originally, we have been planning on releasing Hunting Simulator VR on December 13th; But unfortunately, we decided to delay the release by a few days. We need to spend a little more time hammering out some of the game mechanics. Mainly, we would like to release a game that every single player would enjoy and be as bug free as possible. 

Thank you all for your patience and hope you have a wonderful day!
